subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - AuroraHealth (clarifying questions)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + SIG questionnaire (post-call)

Hi Sophie — great to meet earlier. Thanks for taking the time to walk through Aurora Health's use case and timeline. Per our call, summary and next steps below:

- Use case: PHI-enabled clinical decision support during intake; expected volume ~250k tokens/day.
- Timeline: pilot in Q3, production depending on procurement timeline.
- Ask: to move security review forward, we'll initiate the SIG questionnaire. I've attached our SIG spreadsheet and a short security pack that includes high-level architecture, SOC 2 status, and our DPA.

Quick answers from the call: we are SOC 2 Type II in progress (testing started Jan 2027; expected report Q4 2027), we support signing a BAA for PHI workloads, and we have a GDPR-compliant DPA available. Still happy to provide more detail as needed.

Could you confirm these clarifying items so we fill the right scope in the SIG?
1) Will Aurora consider Redwood as in-scope processor for PHI under a BAA (yes/no)?
2) Which geography will store aggregated logs (US-only or EU too)?
3) Any specific encryption/KMS requirements (customer-managed keys required?)

Next steps:
- Sophie: confirm the three items above and share any vendor onboarding doc you prefer (we can also fill the SIG directly).
- Camila/Marissa: we will provide answers and link to supporting artifacts (SOC2 letter when available, pen test summary).

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_v2.xlsx; Redwood_Security_Pack.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call if helpful.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@aurorahealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + SIG questionnaire (post-call)

Camila — thanks for the recap and attachments. A few clarifying items from our security and procurement teams:

- We do need Redwood to act as a processor under a signed BAA for PHI workloads; that is a must.
- Logs: we prefer US-only storage for now (Aurora may request EU later).
- KMS: our security team prefers customer-managed keys (BYOK) for encryption at rest, but we can accept Redwoods' managed keys if BYOK is not available — please indicate which you support.

Also — procurement asked whether you can fill our vendor onboarding PDF (attached) instead of the SIG, or provide both. Which is faster for you?

Finally, can you confirm the current SOC 2 status in one sentence we can pass to leadership?

I'll route to procurement and security once we have your answers.

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Head of Vendor Risk
Aurora Health

Attachment: Aurora_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + SIG questionnaire (post-call)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the quick questions. Answers below (and copying Marissa from Security for any deeper follow-up):

1) BAA: Yes — Redwood can sign a BAA for PHI workloads. We have a standard BAA we can share; if Aurora has a preferred template we can review redlines.

2) Logs / data residency: Default is US-only for customer data and aggregated logs. If you need EU residency we can discuss a private deployment/region-specific routing as part of the Dedicated/Private offering.

3) KMS / encryption: We support Redwood-managed keys (default) and also offer customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted API we support envelope encryption with customer-supplied keys for select customers — Marissa (cc) can confirm details and next steps for BYOK.

SOC 2 status (one-liner for leadership): "Redwood is currently operating under SOC 2 Type II testing; controls testing began Jan 2027 and completion/attestation is expected in Q4 2027. A SOC 2 letter can be provided once the report is issued."

Regarding the onboarding doc: we can do either. Fastest path is usually for Aurora to share the preferred template and we fill the SIG in parallel. If procurement prefers the Aurora form filled first we can prioritize that — please confirm.

Supporting artifacts and links:
- Shared security pack (public): https://drive.google.com/redwood-security-pack-aurora
- SOC 2 & pen test: will share as soon as final reports are available (expect Q4 2027)
- DocuSign link (for BAA): https://www.docusign.com/ts/Redwood-SIG

Marissa: can you confirm BYOK support for hosted vs dedicated and any lead time we should call out?

Thanks — happy to set a 30-minute sync with our security engineer if that helps speed review.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

I’ll update the HubSpot deal (RDW-4592) after procurement opens the ticket.

Appreciate the responsiveness — Sophie
